scope: Input-only serial prompt-prefill completion positions with infinite prompt-prefix cache; no EOS, decode, bounded KV cache, concurrent GPU timing, or online counterfactual

model.reusable_prefix_rule: first (P-1)//16 complete prefix blocks are computed at most once globally
model.mandatory_tail_rule: each request computes remaining 1..16 prompt tokens
model.completion_position: cumulative new prefix-block plus mandatory-tail token work at that request
model.p95_method: nearest rank, sorted value at ceil(0.95 * 150) - 1

prediction: This serial infinite-cache prompt-only model compares work completion positions; it does not predict GPU latency or throughput benefits.
